name: manage_channels
title: Manage WhatsApp channels

action.description: list, get, scheduled, create, update, post, schedule, cross_post or cancel

id.description: Channel id (…@newsletter), or the scheduled post id (cancel)

description.description: Channel description, up to 2048 characters (create, update)

datetime.description: ISO 8601 date-time in the future (schedule; optional for cross_post: omit to post as soon as the limits allow)

posts.description: Up to 14 posts to schedule in one call, each { text, datetime } (instead of text + datetime)

targets.description: cross_post: up to 10 channel ids (…@newsletter) or community ids (…@g.us), or { id, text } for a per-target text

name: manage_communities
title: Manage WhatsApp communities

action.description: list, get, digest, create, add_groups, remove_groups, announce, schedule_announcement or cancel

id.description: Community id (…@g.us), or the scheduled announcement id (cancel)

group_ids.description: Up to 20 groups the user administers (create, add_groups, remove_groups)

posts.description: Up to 14 posts to schedule in one call, each { text, datetime } (instead of text + datetime)

since.description: digest: ISO 8601 start (default 24 hours ago, at most 7 days)

name: list_channels
title: List WhatsApp channels
description:
List the WhatsApp Channels the user owns, administers or follows: id, name, role, followers, verified, and how many posts are waiting to be posted. Changes nothing.

Example: {}

name: get_channel
title: Get WhatsApp channel
description:
Read one WhatsApp Channel: its details, the latest posts WhatsApp has loaded (text and time) and its waiting scheduled posts. Changes nothing.

Example: { id: "120363000000000001@newsletter" }

name: list_communities
title: List WhatsApp communities
description:
List the user's WhatsApp Communities: id, name, announcement group, number of groups, whether the user is an admin, and how many announcements are waiting. Changes nothing.

Example: {}

name: get_community
title: Get WhatsApp community
description:
Read one WhatsApp Community: its announcement group, its linked groups (members, whether the user can post) and its waiting announcements. Changes nothing.

Example: { id: "120363000000000002@g.us" }
